kind.instructions: What does the feedback of this record tell the agent?

criteria.contents: it lists what is in or on a place, or says the place holds nothing
criteria.arrived: it says the agent is at a place but not what is in or on it
criteria.other: something else: the result of an action, an error, or what is around the agent

carry.instructions: What did this command do to what the agent carries?

criteria.picked up tomato 2: the agent picked up tomato 2 and now carries it
criteria.picked up countertop 3: the agent picked up countertop 3 and now carries it
criteria.put down: the agent moved, put or placed the object it was carrying somewhere, and no longer carries it
criteria.nothing: nothing changed in what the agent carries
